module_title: Countries, Capitals, & Currencies - India's Neighbors & Global Powers
introduction: The 'Countries, Capitals, and Currencies' matrix is an essential high-frequency topic in the Static GK portion of all one-day competitive exams (SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS, Railways, and Bank Clerk). This foundational level sets down core targets by looking at India's immediate neighborhood and the primary global economic superpowers.

core_concepts.title: India's Immediate Neighbors
core_concepts.description:
Questions regarding nations sharing borders with India are heavily prioritized by examiners:
- Pakistan: Capital - Islamabad, Currency - Pakistani Rupee
- Bangladesh: Capital - Dhaka, Currency - Taka
- Nepal: Capital - Kathmandu, Currency - Nepalese Rupee
- Sri Lanka: Capital - Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte (Legislative) / Colombo (Executive), Currency - Sri Lankan Rupee

core_concepts.title: Primary Global Superpowers
core_concepts.description:
Basic geopolitical indicators for the world's most influential nations:
- United States of America (USA): Capital - Washington, D.C., Currency - United States Dollar ($)
- United Kingdom (UK): Capital - London, Currency - Pound正式 Pound Sturgeon/Pound Sterling (£)
- China: Capital - Beijing, Currency - Renminbi (Yuan)
- Russia: Capital - Moscow, Currency - Ruble

important_entities.name: Bangladesh
important_entities.significance: Shares the longest international land border with India. Its parliament is formally known as the 'Jatiya Sangsad'.

important_entities.name: China
important_entities.significance: The official name of the currency system is the 'Renminbi' (RMB), while the basic accounting unit is the 'Yuan'.

important_entities.name: Japan
important_entities.significance: A major technological titan in East Asia. Its historic parliament is called the 'Diet'.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Aspirants frequently mark 'Colombo' as the sole capital of Sri Lanka. Ensure you recognize that 'Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte' is the official administrative and legislative capital, whereas Colombo remains the commercial hub.

Examiners occasionally omit 'Yuan' from the options and print 'Renminbi' instead. Do not get confused; Renminbi is the currency system name, much like Sterling in the UK, whereas Yuan is the unit name.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Rhyme the capital Dhaka directly with its currency Taka for an absolute seamless memory lock under exam pressure.
Phonetically connect the word 'Zen' with the Japanese currency unit 'Yen'.

exam_strategy_tips: Direct matching options pairing a country with its capital form the bulk of simple Static GK points. Keep your neighbor checklist perfectly memorized.
